title: Frontend: Word Counter
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Word Counter. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Count whitespace-separated tokens, zero for blank text. This intentionally uses whitespace segmentation rather than linguistic word boundaries. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Text. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
For a whitespace-delimited exercise, trim, split on runs of whitespace, and return zero for blank text.
alternativeApproaches: Display both a simple whitespace count and a locale-aware count with their definitions.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Blank; repeated whitespace; newlines.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
